description: BEMRosetta is Iñaki Zabala and collaborators' software for viewing, comparing and converting boundary-element hydrodynamic inputs and results. It handles added mass, radiation damping, excitation forces, meshes and selected time-domain files across formats used by WAMIT, AQWA, Nemoh, Capytaine and other tools. Users provide solver files or geometry; outputs include converted files, comparisons and selected derived coefficients. Geographic coverage is equipment-level and user-defined, including ships, floating wind platforms and wave-energy devices. Public source is free under GPL-3.0, with graphical, command-line, library and Python interfaces. A limitation is that supported read and write formats differ, and some interfaces require separately licensed software. Conversion does not establish agreement between physical formulations or mesh resolutions. BEMRosetta can prepare offshore-infrastructure simulations and compare solver behaviour, complementary to Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The README provides a format matrix and cites its 2021 feature paper. No mesh, hydrodynamic archive or executable was downloaded.
